label: rem:q-dilogarithm-properties
title: $\mathrm{Li}_2^q$ as the categorical braiding potential (R-matrix)
html: The universal R-matrix of U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_2) admits the compact q-Pochhammer dilogarithm factorisation of Ludwig D. Faddeev and Rinat M. Kashaev [faddeev_kashaev1994] and Ludwig D. Faddeev [faddeev1994], whose logarithm matches the categorical q-dilogarithm \mathrm{Li}_2^q at leading order so that \mathrm{Li}_2^q acts as the categorical braiding potential. Under archimedean modular-double realisation, Ludwig D. Faddeev's noncompact integral quantum dilogarithm \Phi_b [faddeev1995] supplies the tetrahedral building block of the three-dimensional state-integral topological quantum field theory constructed by Jørgen Ellegaard Andersen and Rinat M. Kashaev [andersen-kashaev2014] (expounded for the Garoufalidis–Kashaev state-integral invariant by Amelia Palmer Dusenbury [dusenbury2025]).
